initial_scope: Five native contact sheets covering 75 captures, plus sampled full-size screenshots and UI/state code; no engine rerun by reviewer.
finding: At 360px the final character of the companion full name was clipped at the right edge.
fix: Split the full name at its first space, preserve the brush font, wrap within the copy column. Add horizontal glyph and scroll-edge assertions and a 30-companion sweep.
final_scope: Verdict pass on the one reported full-name finding, not a new full bot parity audit.
limitations: Contact sheets cover every capture, but full-size views were sampled. No real-device gestures, screen reader, exports, or battle integration audit. Existing design-document drift remains outside scope.
